title: GitHub Actions Workflow Supply-Chain Auditor Input

items.title: GitHub Actions Workflow YAML Payloads to Audit

default.name: ci.yml
default.workflow_yaml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request_target:
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: thirdparty/setup-tool@v2
      - run: echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
